scope: Matched head-only API latency: mode0 native GPU Q8 top10; mode1 native coarse plus graph64-bin selection, exact64 Q8 seeds and bounded residual head; mode2 same bounded head with global coarse top10 seeds. All share backend/driver and weight buffers, original native output scores, packed one-transfer result. Symmetric six-call blocks plus excluded warmups, uncontrolled compile load. No whole-model throughput or adoption claim.
